name: What kind of paint is best for interior doors?

mainEntity.name: What kind of paint is best for interior doors?

acceptedAnswer.text: For interior doors, durable and washable paints are generally recommended. Latex (water-based) paints are popular for their easy cleanup and low odor, often available in satin or semi-gloss finishes which are ideal for high-traffic areas. Alkyd (oil-based) paints offer exceptional durability and a harder finish, resisting scuffs and fingerprints well, though they require mineral spirits for cleanup. Choosing between them depends on desired finish, durability needs, and personal preference.
acceptedAnswer.description: Durable latex or alkyd paints with satin or semi-gloss finishes are best for interior doors.
